# Round three: the scope no longer rests on anybody's claim

RED 32 and GREEN 33 closed F1, F2, F3, F5 and F6; then the SEEN-112 re-measurement caught an over-refusal the
F1 fix had introduced, so RED 34 and GREEN 35 are the citable pair and cover the final state, 347 tests. RED
32's words include `AssertionError: HarnessError not raised` three times for the mis-declared position, the
file the round moved that its slice never names, and the round whose commit has no parent; `AttributeError:
module 'harness.gates' has no attribute '_the_files_the_round_moved'`; F6 reproduced verbatim with git's own
`fatal: ../outside.py ... is outside repository at /private/var/folders/...`; and F2's and F3's counting
failures, `2 != 1`, `3 != 1`, `3 != 0` and `3 == 3`, the last being what `max` bought.

**F1 is established from what the round did rather than from what a record says it did.**
`_the_files_the_round_moved` takes the commit `_the_commit_holding` already finds, diffs it against its first
parent and filters to the paths the fingerprint counts. The comparison is made over the **union** of those
files and the ones the declared slice names, so a declaration can only add files, never remove one: the
mis-declared position in the finding now meets `harness/slice_one.py`, because the commit carrying slice 1's
work moved it, whatever any record claims about position 2. The declared scope was deliberately not replaced,
because a slice may legitimately name a file its round did not happen to move, and replacing would newly
accept a citation that is refused today. Where history cannot answer, the earliest commit holding that content
being a root commit, it falls closed to the whole tree.

**The walk-back is load-bearing and is why there are two pairs.** `_the_commit_holding` returns the newest
commit whose fingerprint matches, and in every journal this harness has written that is a journal-only commit
whose own change the fingerprint excludes. Measured on SEEN-112: check 11's tree is carried by the commit
"docs(SEEN-112): slice 1 note and the handoff pack", so the scoped comparison this ticket exists for had
become unreachable in practice. The fix walks back while no counted path differs, because the parent then
holds the same content by the fingerprint's own definition, and stops at the first commit that moved
something.

**F2 and F3 only lower counts.** Each run is now capped by the plan it actually ran against, so a shorter
plan's correction greens cannot survive into a plan that grew; and a green two records disagree about does not
advance the count at all, which is the gate's fail-closed reading rather than a vote for the larger number. A
round declaring no position is treated the same way, as the gate already does. The literal reading of "a
disagreement is an absence" was rejected with a reason: adding one would point a session past a slice nobody
worked whenever the count had already reached the larger claim, which is higher than the `max` it replaces.

**SEEN-112 re-measured, third time: all fourteen citations refused before and after, nothing accepted.** Four
slice pairs plus four regressions across its four tdd records. Two refusal sentences changed and both are
still refusals in the scoped form, now also naming what the round moved. Its handoff count is unchanged at
three of three, and `slices_proved` returns three instead of four, so the `min()` clamp is no longer hiding an
over-count.

For the ticket file: the code has **four** refusal sentences, not three. There is no such check; the check
recorded no tree at all; the code this check covers has changed, naming what the round moved and what its
slice names; and the tree moved, compared over the whole tree because of one of nine reasons. The Amendment
said three and was wrong, which this record corrects.

Three things left, all named: five README rows still disagree with their own frontmatter, inherited and not
touched; `_require_the_routed_model` still returns immediately while `[routing] shadow` is true, so nothing in
the route comparison would have caught a mis-declared position; and the corroboration remains a necessary
condition, so a slice proved in an attempt that never advanced out of tdd still cannot be cited later.
